name: 长文档结构修复与引用完整性

control_scope_summary: 37项最终有效候选控制加6项基础设施门禁。34项完整矩阵后，两个重启负例修正其重复编号定义的作者样本错误并重跑；另补深色底白字、可选批注缩写省略正例及白底白字负例。评分器仅扩大这两项合法表达，旧矩阵33份现存Word的最终原生读取与检查结果逐项不变，渲染器/聚合器摘要相同；没有宣称43项都在最终同一源码下重新执行完整Office流程。
preview_review_method: all eighteen actual managed-worker PNGs byte-identical to prior reviewed material PNGs
limits: Rule 1.0 does not prove complete task correctness, independent semantic quality, measured L4 difficulty or model/Harness discrimination.
False Word GUI/four-client validation claims intentionally retain rule 1.0; independent semantic Judge must assess honesty, full source/result support and all visual usability.

The first two restart-negative fixtures had duplicate numbering definitions; they were excluded and corrected. Native invariance checks reuse older complete Office renders only where final parsing and structural results are identical and renderer/aggregator hashes did not change.
The standalone validator first correctly rejected an output directory inside its author Workspace. Its registered-source CLI smoke then used a separate external directory and passed.
Full sixty-task freeze and twelve-task four-Harness calibration remain incomplete; H014 separate language-review authorization is still pending.
